event_summary: A yellow mug and a blue upright block on a black circular base slowly change orientation while their dark wall silhouettes move across a lit wall area.
raw_event_description: The scene starts with a yellow mug on a black circular base on a tabletop, with the mug handle visible on the left side and a large dark silhouette on the wall to the left. Over time the mug's visible handle moves out of view, a blue upright rectangular block becomes visible beside the mug, and the wall silhouettes shift from leftward to more central positions. Later the mug handle becomes visible on the right side, the blue block appears near the front-left side of the mug, and the dark silhouettes on the wall continue changing shape and position within the bright circular light area.

reasons: The yellow mug and black circular base are clearly visible.
The blue upright block is not initially visible or is hidden by the mug.
A wall, tabletop, bright light patch, and dark silhouettes are visible.
